user: How does the review process work and how long does it take?
answer:
Here is how disputes are reviewed, based on Verta's dispute documentation.

**Case states.** A dispute moves through these stages: open, under_review, provisional_credit, resolved_upheld, or resolved_declined. You can withdraw a dispute only while it is open or under_review. A withdrawal is final, and the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

**Review timelines.**
- Card reason codes: a review target of 10 business days.
- Transfer reason codes: a review target of 20 business days.
- Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer can take up to 45 calendar days. In that case you would be notified.

The documentation does not say which category goods_not_received falls under, so I can't confirm which of the first two targets applies to TX-0401 yet.

**Next step.** The dispute for TX-0401 has not been opened. It passed the eligibility check, so it can be filed once you confirm. Please tell me whether you want me to open it for goods not received. Once it is filed, I can't reverse it, but you can withdraw it while it is still open or under review.

fragments.text:
Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Case states
A dispute moves through: open, under_review, provisional_credit,
resolved_upheld, resolved_declined. Only open and under_review cases can be
withdrawn by the customer.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each dispute reason code has its own window, counted in days from the
transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |
